notes.title: The sequel to this game has been released
notes.notes:
The authentic sequel to this game, "Trajectory of summer flower Ⅱ", is now officially available on Steam.

Featuring the original storyline, this sequel contains everything you'd expect from the series (I know what you're thinking). We welcome your support!

Steam Store link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698190/That_summer_of_eternal_eden/

notes.title: New English Text Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello players,

We are happy to announce that the English version script is being edited by Bluemist and his team.

This new update will fix the text box spacing and word wrapping as well as making the English text much more readable.

They hope to have it complete by next week, although the script edits may be released before the text box fixes.

Thank you for playing our game!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/629960/discussions/0/1496741765132530907/]http://steamcommunity.com/app/629960/discussions/0/1496741765132530907/[url]
